query:
SELECT 
  ah.requestId,
  pr.requestNumber,
  pr.urgencyLevel,
  ah.step,
  ah.action,
  ah.userName,
  ah.comment,
  ah.createdAt
FROM approvalHistory ah
JOIN purchaseRequests pr ON pr.id = ah.requestId
WHERE pr.requestNumber IN ('SOL-2026-0157', 'SOL-2026-0161', 'SOL-2026-0160')
ORDER BY ah.requestId, ah.createdAt ASC;
